memory_objects.content: A scoring-based model for memory consolidation is proposed. A topic's score increases with each mention or retrieval, and it moves from short-term to long-term memory upon reaching a certain threshold. Short-term memory is defined as a push-out window where unreinforced items are lost, while high-frequency or high-density discussion leads to persistent long-term memory.
